headline: DeepSeek is refunding a week of user fees after an outage of nearly five hours knocked its chatbot and developer service offline.
score_reason: Real disruption and refund, but a service outage with no security consequence and no cause given.
importance_line: Developers and businesses that build on DeepSeek lost access during working hours, and the company has not said what caused the failure.
summary: CGTN reports that DeepSeek restored its chatbot and developer service after an outage on 15 October 2026 and says in a notice it will refund what users spent from 8 to 14 October as account credit. The company apologised and said it is investigating and removing single points of failure, but did not give the cause, and BigGo Finance counts at least 10 major outages this year.
notes: SCMP link blocked (403); text read at CGTN and BigGo Finance, both reporting DeepSeek's own notice. SCMP also carried the story. BigGo's five-hour and outage-count figures are BigGo's.
